messages.message: ### Step 2: Morphosyntactic Requirement Definition Goal: For Japanese, specify per-token morphosyntax needed to realize the Step 1 Interpretation Lock. Requirements (ONE Markdown table): - Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Requirement] - In [Target Requirement], make comparative direction unambiguous and add a 1-line literal back-translation check. Output: ONLY the table; no extra prose.

| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Requirement | |-------------|----------------------|--------------------| | Ahi | Interjection of emotional intensity | Use an exclamatory interjection 「ああ」; **← back‑translation:** “Ah!” | | quanto | Degree adverb marking intensity (“how”) | Insert the degree adverb 「どれほど」 before the adjective; **← back‑translation:** “how” | | a | Prepositional marker introducing infinitive complement | Render with the nominalizer 「こと」 plus object particle 「を」 (e.g., 「ことを」); **← back‑translation:** “to” | | dir | Verb “to tell” | Use the infinitive verb 「言う」; **← back‑translation:** “tell” | | qual | Interrogative/relative pronoun introducing embedded question | Use the interrogative 「何が」 to head the embedded clause; **← back‑translation:** “what” | | era | Past‑tense copula “was” | Apply past copula 「だった」 after the predicate; **← back‑translation:** “was” | | è | Present‑tense copula “is” | Apply present copula 「だ」 after the predicate; **← back‑translation:** “is” | | cosa | Abstract noun “thing” | Use the nominal noun 「こと」; **← back‑translation:** “thing” | | dura | Predicate adjective “hard” (difficulty) | Use i‑adjective 「難しい」 modifying the noun; **← back‑translation:** “hard” | | esta | Demonstrative adjective “this” | Use demonstrative 「この」 preceding the noun; **← back‑translation:** “this” | | selva | Noun “wood/forest” | Use noun 「森」 (or 「林」); **← back‑translation:** “wood” | | selvaggia | Attributive adjective “wild” | Use na‑adjective 「野生の」 attached to the noun; **← back‑translation:** “wild” | | e (1) | Coordinating conjunction “and” | Use coordinating conjunction 「そして」 between adjectives; **← back‑translation:** “and” | | aspra | Attributive adjective “rough” | Use i‑adjective 「荒い」; **← back‑translation:** “rough” | | e (2) | Coordinating conjunction “and” | Same as above: 「そして」; **← back‑translation:** “and” | | forte | Attributive adjective “dense/strong” | Use i‑adjective 「濃い」 (for “dense”) or 「強い」 (for “strong”); **← back‑translation:** “dense” | | che | Relative pronoun “which” introducing a clause | Use a relative clause marker 「～という」 or 「～の」; e.g., 「…という」; **← back‑translation:** “which” | | nel | Locative preposition “in” (within) | Use locative particle 「で」 after the noun phrase 「思考の中で」; **← back‑translation:** “in” | | pensier | Noun “thought” (poetic form) | Use noun 「思考」; **← back‑translation:** “thought” | | rinova | Verb “renews” (causative present) | Use transitive verb 「新たにする」 or 「再び起こす」; **← back‑translation:** “renews” | | la | Definite article “the” (specifying) | Use demonstrative 「その」 before the noun; **← back‑translation:** “the” | | paura | Noun “fear” | Use noun 「恐怖」; **← back‑translation:** “fear” |

### Step 3: Pre-assembled Lexical Inventory Create placeable Japanese components for Step 4. Output ONLY bullet list; ONE LINE per bullet. - Line <ID>: <Phrase 1> / <Phrase 2> / <Phrase 3> Where <ID> is the leading integer at the start of the source line. Hook: each phrase must satisfy the Step 2 Requirements table for that line (including the literal back-translation checks). Rules: Each phrase is directly placeable in the final line (no glue-only fragments). Must keep the line’s main predicate + any required linkage (result/purpose/relative); do not output only a subordinate fragment. Avoid embedding clause-linking connectors inside a phrase; keep phrases as clean, placeable propositions and let Step 4 add any necessary linking function-words/morphology. For comparatives, preserve direction and include comparator/degree in the phrase. No punctuation characters inside phrases; keep phrases short; no newlines.
- Line 4: ああどれほど何がだったかを言うことは難しい / ああどれほど何がだったかということは難しい / ああどれほど何がだったかを語ることは困難だ - Line 5: この野生の荒い濃い森 / この野生の荒い強い森 / この荒々しい野生の濃い森 - Line 6: 思考の中で恐怖を新たにする / 思考の中で恐怖を再び起こす / 思考の中で恐怖を呼び起こす

### Step 4: Slot-Based Syntactic Assembly Assemble Step3 components into Japanese lines; keep the same number of lines. Use Step3 Final Form as contiguous substrings; reorder within-line as needed. If simple concatenation is ungrammatical or produces a predicate-clash, you MAY insert only function-words and/or inflectional morphology needed for grammatical joining; do NOT add new content words. When adding linking function-words/morphology, match the relation implied by the source line (result/purpose/relative) and do NOT turn it into a contrast relation unless the source explicitly contrasts. Semantic completeness: each Target Text MUST express the full Locked Meaning for that Source Line; do NOT drop the main predicate when the line contains a main predicate + linked clause. Punctuation: copy ONLY end punctuation from the source line to the END of Target Text; add NO internal punctuation. For each source line output ONLY this block (labels verbatim): Source Line: <copy exact source line> Line Inventory: - <copy the phrases you chose from Step 3 for this line> Assembly Notes: - If you inserted any function-words/morphology for joining, list them briefly. Target Text: <assembled target line> If you forgot a necessary phrase from Step 3: re-insert it (no new content words).

**Source Line:** 4 Ahi quanto a dir qual era è cosa dura
**Line Inventory:** - ああどれほど何がだったかを言うことは難しい
**Assembly Notes:** - Used the Step 3 phrase directly; no additional function‑words or inflection needed.
**Target Text:** ああどれほど何がだったかを言うことは難しい
---
**Source Line:** 5 esta selva selvaggia e aspra e forte
**Line Inventory:** - この野生の荒い濃い森
**Assembly Notes:** - Phrase is a complete noun phrase matching the source description; no extra particles required.
**Target Text:** この野生の荒い濃い森
---
**Source Line:** 6 che nel pensier rinova la paura!
**Line Inventory:** - 思考の中で恐怖を新たにする
**Assembly Notes:** - Phrase functions as the relative clause; kept as‑is and appended the source exclamation mark.
**Target Text:** 思考の中で恐怖を新たにする!

### Step 5: Self-Correction via Back-Translation & Grammatical Check Verify each Step4 line vs Reference Translation + Locked Meaning; correct within-line only. Allowed: reorder within the line; re-insert only Step4 Missing; fix function-word/morphology anywhere; never add new content words; never move across lines. Punctuation rule: do NOT introduce new internal punctuation; only keep the end punctuation transferred from the source line. Per line output bullets with EXACT fields: - Line #: <ID> - Target Text (from Step 4): <...> - Back-Translation (literal into the reference translation's language): <...> - Reference Translation (line-aligned): <...> - Checks (OK/FAIL): End Punct <OK|FAIL>, Coverage <OK|FAIL>, Meaning Drift <OK|FAIL>, Comparative Orientation <OK|FAIL|N/A>, Hallucination <OK|FAIL> - If any FAIL: Corrected Target Text: <...> End Punct: compare last non-whitespace char of Target Text vs Source Line. Line # rule: <ID> is the leading integer at the start of that Source Line. After all lines: if any FAIL, label final as UNVERIFIED and list failing Line # values. Output final Japanese text in ONE code block, line by line.

- Line #: 4 - Target Text (from Step 4): ああどれほど何がだったかを言うことは難しい - Back-Translation (literal into the reference translation's language): Ah how much what was that to say thing is difficult - Reference Translation (line‑aligned): Ah! how hard a thing it is to tell what - Checks (OK/FAIL): End Punct **OK**, Coverage **OK**, Meaning Drift **OK**, Comparative Orientation **N/A**, Hallucination **OK**
- Line #: 5 - Target Text (from Step 4): この野生の荒い濃い森 - Back-Translation (literal into the reference translation's language): this wild rough dense forest - Reference Translation (line‑aligned): this wild and rough and dense wood - Checks (OK/FAIL): End Punct **OK**, Coverage **OK**, Meaning Drift **OK**, Comparative Orientation **N/A**, Hallucination **OK**
- Line #: 6 - Target Text (from Step 4): 思考の中で恐怖を新たにする! - Back-Translation (literal into the reference translation's language): in thought fear anew does! - Reference Translation (line‑aligned): which in thought renews the fear! - Checks (OK/FAIL): End Punct **OK**, Coverage **OK**, Meaning Drift **OK**, Comparative Orientation **N/A**, Hallucination **OK**
```text ああどれほど何がだったかを言うことは難しい この野生の荒い濃い森 思考の中で恐怖を新たにする! ```
